subject: Is it possible to create heatmap through Skyline?

messages.author: 60dea536e3efa934
messages.subject: Is it possible to create heatmap through Skyline?
parts: I can not find how to get a heatmap through MSStat external tools in Skyline? Is this feature of MSStat accessible trough skyline?

messages.author: 60dea536e3efa934
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to create heatmap through Skyline?
parts:
Hello,

In fact our problems is to perform multiple conditions group comparison. We work with 3 conditions (1 bioreplicates per condition, 4 technical replicates per condition) and when we select two contitions (2,3) to compare against the control condition (1) we get a profile plot with 0.5(2+3)-1, whereas we would like to get  2-1, 3-1, 3-2...

messages.author: 085b00b73e467d88
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to create heatmap through Skyline?
parts:
When multiple groups are compared against a control group in the external tool of Skyline, the average level of those groups will be used for the comparison as you noticed. For multiple comparisons of individual groups (and visualization of the results in a heatmap), it's not currently supported in the external tool and you may use MSstats in R. 

HTH
Tsung-Heng
